submitted.rationale: Illumination is 2.06 eV, below the ~2.4 eV gap of BiVO4, so photocurrent depends on phases that absorb in the red. By XRD, index 54 (Bi0.12 Fe0.62 V0.26) contains hematite (peaks at Q≈1.71, 2.33, 2.50) plus monoclinic BiVO4 (Q≈2.04) on the FTO substrate. It gave the highest photocurrent of the three measured compositions, 1.0e-7 A.

rejected.reason: Its XRD shows BiVO4 and FTO only. Photocurrent was 9e-8 A, slightly below index 54.
V-rich and low in Fe; its photocurrent was 0 A under 2.06 eV light.
Bi-rich and contains other Bi-oxide phases by XRD. Not merit-measured because the budget was prioritized for compositions with absorbing phases.
